# Button

Button: triggers an action.

Also asked as: cta, submit.

## Usage

Use `Button` for an action on the current page: submit a form, mark attendance, close a dialog.

### Appearance guidance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Most actions that are not the main call to action of a page or area, and the secondary half of a footer. Draws a soft neutral fill with no outline. Example: "Reschedule session". |
| Primary | The main call to action or a form submission. One per page or area. Example: "Book session". |
| Subtle | Secondary actions in headers, toolbars and button groups. Example: "Cancel" in a Popup. Never "Not now": a declining action is a Default secondary in the left half of a footer. |
| Warning | Confirms an action that may cause a significant change or a loss of data, often in a confirmation modal. Example: "Remove from this week". |
| Danger | The final confirmation of a destructive, irreversible action. Example: "Delete session recording". |
| Link | An action that leaves: text in the brand color with no fill, underlined on hover. It fills a footer's leading slot. Use it on a `LinkButton` to leave the page, or on a `Button` to leave the task. Examples: "Save and exit", "Open profile". |
| Danger link | A footer's leading destructive action: danger-colored text with no fill, so every leading action lines up as text. Example: "Delete", "Discard". Use Danger for the final confirmation. |
| Discovery | The call to action for a new experience. Example: "Try the new schedule view". |
| AI | The one primary AI action in a region. Draws the sparkle before its label. Example: "Generate summary". |

| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Hover and press change color, 90% by about 110 ms. |

## Alternatives

- For navigation to another page or site in the look of a button, use `LinkButton`.
- For an action shown as an icon with no visible label, use `IconButton`.
- For a primary action joined to a menu of related variations, use `SplitButton`.
- For a menu of actions behind one trigger, use `DropdownMenu`.

## Best practices

### Use one primary action per area. {#use-one-primary-action-per-area}

Do: One primary button, with the secondary action subtle beside it.
Don't: Two primary buttons in one area compete for attention.

### Use one primary AI action per region. {#use-one-primary-ai-action-per-region}

The `ai` appearance marks the main AI action in a region, such as "Generate summary" on session notes. Use it only for actions that call AI, and leave its look as shipped (the sparkle is always drawn and a label is required). Every other AI action in the region is a `default` or `subtle` button with an AI icon.

Do: One AI button for the region's main AI action, with the other actions subtle.
Don't: A second AI button competes with the first, and Save notes is not an AI action.

### Pick the spacing for the surrounding space. {#pick-the-spacing-for-the-surrounding-space}

Use `default` spacing in most places, `compact` for tables, headers and inline popups, and `spacious` in modal and panel footers.

### Keep an action enabled and explain on press. {#keep-an-action-enabled-and-explain-on-press}

An action that is not ready stays enabled. When pressed, move focus to the first field that needs attention and show the reason there, or in a warning `SectionMessage` above when it blocks the main action. Disable a button only while it is sending (`isLoading`), or when the reason is self-evident, such as Back on the first step. A button for something a role can never do is left out. See [Disabled](?path=/docs/patterns-states-disabled--docs).

Do: Enabled, with the reason shown as text when the button is pressed.
Don't: A disabled submit button gives no direction and leaves the tab order.

### Align the primary button with its group. {#align-the-primary-button-with-its-group}

In Modal and Panel footers, `FooterActions` places the primary action in the rightmost track. On single-page forms and full-page tasks, left-align buttons with the primary first.

## Accessibility

- **Action vs. navigation.** `Button` renders a `<button>`; use `LinkButton` for navigation so screen readers announce the right role.
- **Disabled state.** A disabled button leaves the tab order, receives no events, and never takes a tooltip or an `aria-disabled` stand-in. See [Disabled](?path=/docs/patterns-states-disabled--docs).
- **Icon-only buttons.** A button with no visible label is an `IconButton`, which requires a `label`.
- **Focus.** The focus ring is 2px in `--ds-border-focused`. Never remove it.
- **Loading and selected.** `isLoading` blocks interaction, sets `aria-busy`, and keeps the label in the accessibility tree. `isSelected` sets `aria-pressed`.

## Related

- `FooterActions`: use when placing spacious buttons across the four-track footer slot of a Modal or Panel.
- `IconButton`: use when space allows only an icon with a tooltip label.
- `LinkButton`: use when the control navigates to another page or URL.
- `ButtonGroup`: use when related buttons sit together in a connected row.
- `DropdownMenu`: use when a trigger opens a list of actions.
- `ProgressBar`: use when showing progress on the page rather than inside the button.

## Parts

1. **Container.** Soft neutral fill (`--ds-background-neutral`) with no border on `default`, transparent on `subtle`, and bold semantic fills on `primary`, `warning`, `danger`, `discovery` and `ai`. Draws `32` high (`--control-md`) at `default` spacing, `24` (`--control-sm`) at `compact`, and `48` (`--control-xl`) at `spacious` inside `FooterActions`. Stretches to its parent's width with `shouldFitContainer`, keeping the label centered.
2. **Icon before** (optional). A Font Awesome Free glyph at `16` (`--icon-md`), before the label (`ai` always draws its sparkle).
3. **Label.** Body/default at the medium weight, centered in the container; truncates with an ellipsis when constrained.
4. **Icon after** (optional). A Font Awesome Free glyph at `16` (`--icon-md`), or `12` (`--icon-sm`) for a trailing chevron.
5. **Spinner** (loading only). A `16` `Spinner` in the label color that replaces the label and icons while the button is busy.

Most buttons need no icon. Add one only when the glyph has an established meaning, such as `plus` for add.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Hovered | The container takes the appearance's hovered fill. The label and icon keep their colors. |
| Pressed | The container takes the appearance's pressed fill. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the edge, for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | The selected role fill, 1px `--ds-border-selected` edge, label and icon. Applies to default and subtle, and sets `aria-pressed`. |
| Disabled | The disabled fill, label and icon: a change of color, not of opacity. Subtle stays transparent. |
| Loading | A 16 `Spinner` replaces the label and icons. The container keeps its fill, blocks interaction and sets `aria-busy`. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill: default, subtle | `--ds-background-neutral` (default) and `--ds-background-neutral-subtle` (subtle), each with hovered and pressed steps. Neither draws an edge. |
| Fill: primary, warning, danger, discovery | `--ds-background-brand-bold`, `-warning-bold`, `-danger-bold`, `-discovery-bold`, each with hovered and pressed steps. |
| Fill: AI | `--ds-ai-background-bold`, with hovered and pressed steps. |
| Fill: selected, disabled | `--ds-background-selected` with hovered and pressed steps and a 1px `--ds-border-selected` edge; `--ds-background-disabled`. |
| Label and icon | `--ds-text` and `--ds-icon` (default); `--ds-text-subtle` and `--ds-icon-subtle` (subtle); `--ds-text-inverse` and `--ds-icon-inverse` (primary, danger, discovery, ai); `--ds-text-warning-inverse` (warning); the selected and disabled roles. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |
| Height | Default 32: `--control-md`. Compact 24: `--control-sm`. Spacious 48: `--control-xl`. |
| Padding | Default 12: `--pad-x-md`. Compact 8: `--pad-x-sm`. Spacious 16: `--pad-x-lg`. |
| Radius | Default 6: `--button-radius-default`. Compact 4: `--button-radius-compact`. Spacious 10: `--button-radius-spacious`. |
| Icon-to-label gap | 4: `--inline-sm`. |
| Label | Body/default at the medium weight; icons at 16 (`--icon-md`), chevrons at 12 (`--icon-sm`). |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use sentence case: "Add student". | Title case or all capitals: "Add Student", "ADD STUDENT". |
| Keep the label short and free of punctuation: "Save notes". | "Save the notes for this session." |
| Start with a verb and name what is acted on: "Confirm session time". | Vague labels such as "OK", "Yes" or "Submit". |
| Use the same words as the heading and related text in view. | Different words for the same action within one view. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string | — | The label. Children work too. |
| `children` | node | — | The label, used when `text` is not given. Omit both for an icon-only button. |
| `title` | string | — | The `title` attribute, a native tooltip on hover. It is left off while the button is disabled or loading. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'default'` | The visual style. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | Height and padding: `default` draws 32, `compact` draws 24, `spacious` draws 48. Compact is for tables and tight toolbars; spacious is for modal and panel footers. |
| `shouldFitContainer` | bool | `false` | Stretches the button to the width of its container, with the label centered. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names added to the button element beside the component's own. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Called with the click event when the button is activated by mouse or keyboard. It does not fire while `isDisabled` or `isLoading` is set. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Prevents interaction. Avoid it; see Usage. |
| `isSelected` | bool | — | Marks the button selected and sets `aria-pressed`. |
| `isLoading` | bool | `false` | Shows a spinner in place of the label and blocks interaction. |
| `type` | string | `'button'` | The native button `type`: `button` (default), `submit` or `reset`. Used only when the button renders as a `button` element. |
| `as` | elementType | — | Renders the button as this element or component instead, such as a router link. Without it the button is an anchor when `href`, `target` or `rel` is set, otherwise a `button`. |
| `href` | string | — | Renders as an anchor when set (and no `as` overrides it). |
| `target` | string | — | The anchor `target` attribute, such as `_blank`. Used only when the button renders as an anchor. |
| `rel` | string | — | The anchor `rel` attribute. Used only when the button renders as an anchor. |
| `role` | string | — | Overrides the default `"button"` ARIA role an anchor-rendered Button takes (e.g. `LinkButton`'s own `"link"`). |
| `iconBefore` | string or node | — | A Font Awesome Free glyph name, or a node, before the label. |
| `iconAfter` | string or node | — | A Font Awesome Free glyph name, or a node, after the label. |
| `id` | string | — | The `id` attribute of the rendered element. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid`, for test queries. |
